+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DocumentClientConfig:
+    region: Optional[str] = None
+    confidence_threshold: float = 0.0
+
+
+def load_config(config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> DocumentClientConfig:
+    config = config or {}
+    return DocumentClientConfig(
+        region=config.get("region") or os.getenv("AWS_REGION"),
+        confidence_threshold=float(config.get("confidence_threshold", 0.0)),
+    )
+
+
+def get_textract_client(config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
+    settings = load_config(config)
+    return boto3.client("textract", region_name=settings.region)
+
+
+def document_bytes(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
+    return payload["document_bytes"]

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ExpenseItem:
+    description: Optional[str] = None
+    quantity: Optional[str] = None
+    amount: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def field_text(fields: List[Dict[str, Any]], field_type: str, default: str = "") -> str:

+import boto3
+
+from document_models import field_text
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("textract", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    response = client.analyze_expense(Document={"Bytes": payload["document_bytes"]})
+    receipts = []
+    for document in response["ExpenseDocuments"]:
+        summary = document.get("SummaryFields", [])
+        items = []
+        for group in document.get("LineItemGroups", []):
+            for item in group.get("LineItems", []):
+                values = {f["Type"]["Text"]: f["ValueDetection"].get("Text", "") for f in item.get("LineItemExpenseFields", [])}
+                items.append({"description": values.get("ITEM"), "quantity": values.get("QUANTITY"), "amount": values.get("PRICE")})
+        receipts.append({
+            "merchant": field_text(summary, "VENDOR_NAME"),
+            "tax": field_text(summary, "TAX"),
+            "total": field_text(summary, "TOTAL"),
+            "items": items,
+        })
+    return {"receipts": receipts}
*** Add File: normalize_expense.py
+from document_models import normalize_expense_schema
+
+
+def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    expense = payload.get("expense", payload)
+    normalized = normalize_expense_schema(expense)
+    normalized["currency"] = config.get("currency", expense.get("currency", "USD"))
+    return {"normalized_expense": normalized}
*** Add File: validate_document_fields.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("textract", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    expense = payload.get("expense", payload)
+    required = ["vendor", "date", "total"]
+    missing = [field for field in required if not expense.get(field)]
+    confidence = float(expense.get("confidence", 1.0))
+    min_confidence = float(config.get("min_confidence", 0.8))
+    valid = not missing and confidence >= min_confidence and client.meta.service_model.service_name == "textract"
+    return {"valid": valid, "missing_fields": missing, "confidence": confidence}
*** Add File: invoice_summary.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def invoice_summary(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    invoice = payload.get("invoice", payload)
+    summary = f"Vendor {invoice.get('vendor', '')} total {invoice.get('total', '')} dated {invoice.get('date', '')}".strip()
+    if invoice.get("notes"):
+        client.detect_sentiment(Text=invoice["notes"], LanguageCode=config.get("language", "en"))
+    return {"summary": summary}
*** Add File: vendor_text_safety.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def vendor_text_safety(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    text = payload.get("text", payload.get("notes", ""))
+    labels = client.classify_document(Text=text, EndpointArn=config.get("endpoint_arn")) if text and config.get("endpoint_arn") else {"Classes": []}
+    unsafe = any(item.get("Name") == "Hate_Speech" for item in labels.get("Classes", []))
+    return {"safe": not unsafe, "labels": labels.get("Classes", [])}
*** Add File: invoice_note_translate.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def invoice_note_translate(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    text = payload.get("text", payload.get("note", ""))
+    target = config.get("target_language", "en")

+

+def validate_document_fields(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("textract", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    expense = payload.get("expense", payload)
+    required = ["vendor", "date", "total"]
+    missing = [field for field in required if not expense.get(field)]
+    confidence = float(expense.get("confidence", 1.0))
+    min_confidence = float(config.get("min_confidence", 0.8))
+    valid = not missing and confidence >= min_confidence and client.meta.service_model.service_name == "textract"
+    return {"valid": valid, "missing_fields": missing, "confidence": confidence}

+    client = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.get("region"))
